mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have clear skies tonight with a temperature of 51 degrees, which feels like 47. It is a peaceful night over the Military Ridge State Trail, illuminated by a beautiful waxing gibbous moon.

In city news, road maintenance is scheduled to begin on Monday, September 28th, with contractors starting crack filling across several zones. Roads will remain open, but prepare for temporary lane closures and traffic control. Also, the Plan Commission has multiple development projects on the agenda for their meeting on Monday, October fifth, including site plans for Sub-Zero in the Liberty Business Park.

For local events, you can enjoy trivia today at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, or Paddy Mac's. Tomorrow, look forward to the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, and more trivia at The Bogey Factory. Plus, the award-winning Verona Fall Fest is coming up on Friday, September 25th.
In the police weekly recap, on Thursday, September third, a 33-year-old Madison man was arrested for O W I, second offence, after crashing his vehicle in the 700 block of Shooting Star Road.
Culver's opens today at 10:00 AM with today's flavor listed as closed for remodeling, so be sure to check their status if you are planning a visit.
